study type: Secondary analysis of two population-based studies
outcome: Adverse maternal outcome (major obstetric hemorrhage, hysterectomy, mortality)
Use and timing of resuscitation and transfusion management
cohort: Women with severe PPH (defined as total blood loss ≥ 1500 ml AND blood transfusion of ≥ 4 units packed red blood cells and/or multicomponent blood transfusion) in France and the Netherlands.
finding: The incidence of adverse maternal outcome after vaginal birth was significantly higher in the Netherlands compared to France, and this difference persisted after stratification by mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Incidence of adverse maternal outcome was higher after cesarean delivery in both France and the Netherlands.
